questions.q: What does a column mask function return, compared to a row filter function?
options: A value of the same type as the masked column, instead of a boolean
Always a boolean, exactly like a row filter
An integer error code
Nothing — masks don't use functions at all
questions.explain: A row filter returns true/false to include or exclude a row. A column mask returns a value of the masked column's type — the real value or a redacted substitute.

questions.q: In `ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN ssn SET MASK ssn_mask;`, what does a user who is NOT in the HumanResourceDept group see when they run SELECT * FROM users?
options: The ssn column shown as '***-**-****'
An error — they cannot query the table at all
The real ssn value, same as HR
A NULL value for every column
questions.explain: The CASE expression in ssn_mask returns the masked literal for anyone not in HumanResourceDept, while the rest of the row is returned normally.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the `USING COLUMNS` clause when applying a column mask?
options: It passes additional columns or constants into the masking function beyond the masked column itself
It lists which columns are allowed to be queried at all
It specifies which catalog the mask function lives in
It disables the mask for specific columns
questions.explain: USING COLUMNS supplies extra arguments — like another column's value in the same row — that the masking function needs for conditional logic beyond the masked column.

questions.q: Why can't you apply a Python UDF directly as a column mask with SET MASK?
options: SET MASK only accepts a SQL function; a Python UDF must be wrapped in a SQL function that calls it
Python UDFs are not allowed in Unity Catalog at all
Column masks only work on STRING columns
Python UDFs can only be used as row filters, never as masks
questions.explain: Applying the Python UDF directly raises a ROUTINE_NOT_FOUND error; the fix is a SQL wrapper function that calls the Python UDF, and the wrapper is what gets applied as the mask.

questions.q: What does `ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN ssn DROP MASK;` do?
options: Removes the column mask so all users see the original, unmasked column values
Deletes the ssn column from the table entirely
Deletes the underlying masking function
Masks the column for every user, including HR
questions.explain: DROP MASK detaches the masking function from the column; future queries return the real, unmasked values for all users regardless of group membership.
